mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI inflation rate above 3.5% per annum signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a weak labor market, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically signals an economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in monthly payroll growth below 50,000 jobs signals weak labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 50,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals a tight monetary policy response to high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.5% (as measured by GDPC1) signals a slowing economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
